Online: client listener mp.ts:76-80 and host-only types protocol.ts:164-165 and 188-189 are the intended slots for shared phone or death state, but they have no sender in src. Any shared home or death state needs a new host-authoritative message wired on both sides.
risks: Quota miss is decided at dawn() (run.ts:1963) and the trapdoor fall() runs there. A home-then-mafia death changes that ordering, and dawn() also owns overshoot tiers (1968-1977), Night-card offers (1999), hollow dawn cleanup (1818), and rope_ladder/false_bottom saves (1948-1962). Any deferral must keep all of these.

No Night deadline clock exists. Settle can end a Night early via settleEarly (run.ts:1556-1571, skipRest 1568), so a Night-length countdown would not be reliable. A threat schedule keyed to time must key off Watch index and quota progress.

Timers ignore clockHeld in the closing, settle, and collection phases (run.ts:1434-1445). Cutscenes and the Dawn horror walk (ingame/session.ts:270) do not pause the 12 s collection timer. Home waits need an explicit hold policy. The project rule is app.timers.sim (core/timers.ts:2-6), which run.ts does not use.
Phone is off outside play/lastCall: hotline.ts:574-577 and rescue cutoff run.ts:2463. Spouse messages at home need their own gate or they stay silent.

restore() sets phase directly and emits no shift:phase or run:window (run.ts:3490, constructor 1048-1049). Listeners that re-arm on phase change (hotline.ts:574, ingame/session.ts:267) do not run after a reload into home.

Clock resume contradiction: the comment at run.ts:554 says the Watch clock 'resumes frozen', but clock.ts:46 restores running from the snapshot. I did not find where the freeze happens. Treat as unverified.

Naming collision: the Topside 'elevator' already exists as the Night-8 choice (panels.ts:251, run.ts:1770) and the ending_elevator cutscene (story/index.ts:112). The new elevator-to-apartment needs a distinct id or a deliberate reuse.

Topside gating: openFloor refuses while topside is true (run.ts:1487), and topside is set at BASE_RUN_NIGHTS (1996). Overdrawn Nights 9+ (schedule.ts:116-131) run after that, so home sleep must work with topside cleared (goBackDown 1773-1778).

Multiplayer: each peer runs its own DebtRun (ingame/session.ts:92-99). Only the co-op quota display is broadcast (mp.ts:105-109). rsnap/phone/phoneAns/end are declared (protocol.ts:164, 188-189, 137) but have no sender in src. A death or phone choice is therefore local to a peer, and determinism comes only from the seed, as hotline.ts:556 does with hashSeed.
Module-level state: WatchEvents.live (watchEvents.ts:83) assumes one run per page. Do not copy this pattern for home state.
Any new RunApi member must be added to BenchRun (benchRun.ts:104) or stubbed through the inert() helper (run.ts:562-574), or the typecheck breaks.
Night cards and overpay modals gate the Dawn summary (inGameState.ts:249-253), and online runs skip the Night-card UI (ingame/session.ts:101-102). The home UI needs the same online policy.
suggestion:
Keep ShiftPhase unchanged to avoid ripple into hotline.ts:576, tutorial.ts:291-314, inGameState.ts:244-267, and charms/engines.ts:220. Model home as an optional stage in RunExt (for example home?: {stage: 'elevator'|'home'|'doomed', left, phone state}) that defaults to absent. Like topside (run.ts:1061, 3149), it is a flag on intermission, so it is saved and restored with the rest of ext.

Minimal plan: (1) dawn() paid branch (run.ts:1995-2000): set home stage 'elevator' instead of entering a plain Mola when the design wants the trip; the Mola lever stays available behind it. (2) dawn() miss branch (run.ts:1963): if the design wants the mafia death at home, set stage 'doomed' and persist instead of fall(); fall() stays the trapdoor path. (3) Home tick: decrement stage time inside run.tick's switch (run.ts:1422-1448), decided by sim dt, with an explicit clockHeld policy. (4) Home phone: a createHotline-shaped scheduler seeded by hashSeed(seed, night, 'home', k) (hotline.ts:556 pattern), wired next to run.ts:959 and ticked at run.ts:1409, with its own live gate. (5) Sleep: call an extracted beginNight() from openFloor's body (run.ts:1501-1533). (6) Death: endRun('fell', 'mafia') via fall() (run.ts:2017-2022), add a story branch at story/index.ts:109-113 plus a new cutscene. (7) Save: add optional RunExt fields, written at run.ts:3146-3183 and read at 3487-3564, with v:1 kept. Online: state that home and death are per-peer and seeded, or add a host-authoritative message later (protocol.ts:164, 188-189; mp.ts:76-80). Verify the clock-resume claim (run.ts:554 vs clock.ts:46) before relying on it.
